title: Four finishing passes in one 2x2 grid
caption: mgvideo multicam tiles four clips that start on the same frame of the talking-head edit into one 2x2 grid: the original, the warm-vibrant grade (f04), the vignette (f10) and the 1.5x speed-up (f13). The sound is the original's.
prompt: Put four versions of the talking-head edit in one 2x2 grid for a client review: the original from 2 s (cut from ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4), the colour grade (../videos/f04-color-grade.mp4), the vignette (../videos/f10-vignette.mp4) and the 1.5x speed-up (../videos/f13-speed.mp4). They all start at 2 s of the edit, so keep them in sync, use the original's audio, and name each cell with a small Geist label (labels.svg, fonts/).
commands: ffmpeg -i work/grid.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/final.mp4
